gen_risks.description: CO2 leakage from deep offshore geological storage sites during operations.
gen_risks.mitigation: Government underwrites high-impact CO2 leakage risks via the Supplementary Compensation Agreement (SCA) while T&SCo installs sentinel and monitoring wells.
gen_risks.evidence: underwrite several key high-impact, low-probability risks – principally relating to CO2 leakage

gen_risks.description: Capture plant operational underperformance through low plant availability or low carbon capture rates.
gen_risks.mitigation: Enforce financial performance penalties and availability incentive structures under the business model contracts.
gen_risks.evidence: penalties faced by projects caused by underperformance (i.e. low availability or capture rate)

gen_risks.description: Structural failure or refurbishment delays when repurposing existing offshore gas pipelines.
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct rigorous technical assurance and remediation of the Point of Ayr offshore pipeline network during Phase 1 APDP execution.
gen_risks.evidence: remediation/refurbishing of the existing offshore pipeline network from PoA to HM and HN injection sites

gen_risks.description: Construction capital expenditure overruns incurred by the T&SCo during network build-out.
gen_risks.mitigation: Apply a cost-sharing factor limiting T&SCo cost recovery to 40% for overruns and utilize Ofgem uncertain cost reopeners.
gen_risks.evidence: T&SCo will only recoup 40% of any costs in excess of the agreed level

gen_risks.description: Underutilisation of the T&S network causing aggregate user fees to fall short of allowed revenue.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide top-up payments via the exchequer-funded Revenue Support Agreement (RSA) while accelerating top-up and build-out onboarding.
gen_risks.evidence: introduces a risk of network underutilisation and revenue support exposure

gen_risks.description: Shortfall in funds accumulated for long-term network decommissioning obligations.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish a formal Decommissioning Shortfall Agreement managed by the DESNZ Cluster Sponsor Function.

gen_risks.description: Revenue support liabilities reaching defined cap thresholds, triggering network discontinuation rights.
gen_risks.mitigation: Maintain tight budget envelopes, perform ongoing cost assurance, and manage cross-chain risk through the Sponsor Function Board.
gen_risks.evidence: if support provided reaches a defined threshold, DESNZ SoS has the right to discontinue the T&S network

gen_risks.description: Delays in Final Funding Envelope approval forcing postponement of FID and renegotiation or collapse of supplier bids.
gen_risks.mitigation: Progress to FID ahead of the Spending Review or coordinate with delivery partners to negotiate time-limited supplier bid extensions.
gen_risks.evidence: If the approval of the FFE is delayed we would need to postpone FID and developers would need to re-negotiate supplier bids

gen_risks.description: Schedule misalignment between T&SCo and capture plant Commercial Operation Dates leading to premature financial drawdown.
gen_risks.mitigation: Track the integrated cluster delivery schedule and enforce target commissioning dates through the Technical Details Schedule and CfD contracts.
gen_risks.evidence: delivery of a timely cluster COD... to avoid any unnecessary draw down on HMG finances

gen_risks.description: Public undecidedness and local community opposition regarding CCUS infrastructure and onshore pipelines.
gen_risks.mitigation: Execute stakeholder communications plans, demonstrate local economic benefits, and share community engagement best practices.
gen_risks.evidence: awareness of CCUS is growing but with many still undecided of their view.

gen_risks.description: UK ETS carbon prices remaining too low to incentivize private sector decarbonisation without subsidies.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide long-term (15-25 year) business model support contracts linked to carbon price references to bridge the commercial gap.
gen_risks.evidence: Carbon Price is currently too low to incentivise deployment

gen_risks.description: Legal challenges or non-compliance regarding government funding under the Subsidy Control Act 2022.
gen_risks.mitigation: Submit comprehensive subsidy scheme assessments to the Subsidy Advice Unit (SAU) prior to contract execution.
gen_risks.evidence: Cluster Sequencing Process has been developed to align with the UK subsidy control regime under the Subsidy Control Act 2022.

gen_risks.description: Adverse environmental and local air quality impacts from construction activities and plant operations.
gen_risks.mitigation: Enforce strict environmental permitting controls through OPRED and local planning authorities during delivery.
gen_risks.evidence: Costs include the potential for CO2 leakage and environmental and air quality impacts.

gen_risks.description: Capacity and capability deficits within delivery partners (Ofgem, LCCC) restricting effective post-FID execution.
gen_risks.mitigation: Require partner organisations to complete self-assessed Organisational Readiness Statements prior to FID.
gen_risks.evidence: Assess capacity and capability of key partner organisations to deliver their roles at FID

gen_risks.description: Loss of institutional knowledge during transition from negotiation teams to the post-FID operating model.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement an integrated transition and engagement plan and establish the DESNZ Cluster Sponsor Function prior to FID.
gen_risks.evidence: integrated transition & engagement plan will be implemented prior to FID... minimising the loss of institutional knowledge

gen_risks.description: Global supply chain inflation and limited market capacity causing procurement bottlenecks and price escalation.
gen_risks.mitigation: Perform rigorous technical and cost assurance on procurement evidence and conduct early supply chain engagement.
gen_risks.evidence: supply chain cost increases and an unwinding of optimism bias.

gt_risks.description: There is a risk that government (HMG) is exposed to increased costs for Track-1 post-Financial Investment Decision (FID), and that cost pressures are unaffordable within delegated budgets. [Strategic Case risk T1SR1, Section 2.5 'Identify high level potential risks', p.20-21; source rating: High/Possible.]
gt_risks.mitigation: Contractual mechanisms ensure HMG only takes on specific risks where appropriate, with liability limited and counterparties incentivised to control costs; governance mechanisms monitor costs and provide early warning of overruns; contingent liability exposure is accurately monitored.

gt_risks.description: There is a risk that the programme does not realise its intended benefits for Track-1. [Strategic Case risk T1SR3, Section 2.5, p.20-21; source rating: High/Possible.]
gt_risks.mitigation: Projects undergo detailed technical assurance and financial due diligence; projects must meet Initial Conditions Precedent (ICPs) before contracts take effect and Operational CPs thereafter, with LCCC able to terminate and avoid paying for an underperforming project; contractual mechanisms allocate performance-related risk to the private sector; continued engagement with the global Carbon Management Challenge to expand CCUS use and deliver UK trade benefits.

gt_risks.description: There is a risk that the post-FID operating model across public and private sector parties will not operate successfully. [Strategic Case risk T1SR4, Section 2.5, p.20-21; source rating: Medium/Possible.]
gt_risks.mitigation: Progress of arm's-length bodies' (ALBs') capacity (funding, resource) and capability (knowledge, skills) to operate successfully post-FID is monitored through the Delivery Board; a DESNZ Cluster Sponsor Function will be set up between FID and Commercial Operations Date (COD) to mitigate risks to cluster delivery and system integration; readiness-testing mechanisms are in place ahead of FID; FY24/25 funding for the ALBs to fulfil their roles has been secured.

gt_risks.description: There is a risk of an unclear exit path for HMG from its role in the Track-1 commercial framework. [Strategic Case risk T1SR5, Section 2.5, p.20-21; source rating: High/Possible.]
gt_risks.mitigation: Key planned developments include amendments to the process for granting economic licences, a move toward a competitive allocation process for capture contracts, and evolution of transport & storage business models to reflect an increased private-sector role in managing cross-chain risks; cost-reduction levers (UK ETS pricing, CBAMs) are intended to help cultivate a self-sustaining industry and enable an HMG exit path.
